sourceReview.decision: Adopt the existing cited GuitarWorld public preview only for the unambiguous m7–8 cadence. Keep the rest of the 58-attack, 64-beat encoding pending review rather than fabricate a full edition.

historicalReviewNotes.status: Historical pre-2.4.5 claims, retained for provenance and exact reconstruction; not current source verification. The original private photos are unavailable.

currentScopeReview.timebase: Quarter-note beats, zero at the first visible vocal melody attack; 1=C, 4/4, no pickup. No-dot tonic is C4 by repository convention.
currentScopeReview.retainedPracticeTempo: 70 BPM is the retained playback basis, not a tempo marking established by this preview. The historical defaultSpeedFactor 0.9 field is preserved (63 BPM at 0.9x); the current runtime uses the selected or remembered practice multiplier, initially 0.55x (38.5 BPM) without a saved preference.
currentScopeReview.notationDecision: Keep six separate attacks G4, D4, E4, F4, B3, C4; the different-pitch arc is a slur. The F side dot augments duration, the B lower dot lowers its octave, and the two printed quarter rests preserve beats 30–32.
currentScopeReview.unresolvedReason: Preview m3 has upper dots on C/D but none on the following E/D/C; its engraving intent and m4 register remain unresolved. The paid second half, later repeated-looking cadence at beats 57–60, full form and ending were not inspected. Do not mirror the correction or infer a sourceTotalBeats from the retained encoding.
currentScopeReview.limitations: This source-specific two-bar correction does not verify every edition, the unavailable original kalimba photos, complete repeat expansion, unseen paid pages, later rest/ending, harmony, listening quality or public-distribution rights. V2 remains historical source data with a different melody; do not reuse its support until separately reviewed and content-compatible.

suitability.scope: existing 64-beat single-note arrangement; source-specific m7–8 cadence corrected only
suitability.reason: The reviewed cadence fits the fixed F3–E6 natural-note instrument without transposition; the retained song has unresolved register/form evidence and no completed listening or physical play-through. A partial source correction is not whole-song approval.
reviewRequired: Resolve the first-phrase m3–4 octave conflict against the same arrangement or the original kalimba photo.
Verify the unseen second half, repeat/form decisions, later cadence, third rest and final note/extent.

Compare the unaccompanied reviewed phrase to a reference at the retained 70 BPM basis and the actual selected practice multiplier. The first-use 0.55x setting yields 38.5 BPM, but remembered settings may differ; the source has no printed tempo.
Keep incompatible optional support unavailable; any later support needs separate source, rest and A/B listening review.
Physical kalimba hand alternation, jumps and decay have not been tested.
